title: Medical Expense Percentages for Entrance Fee Agreement Tax Letters
content:
Tax statement office table of the percentages the tax letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** states as attributable to medical care, by refund plan, and the date by which the letter is issued.

| Refund plan | Percentage of entrance fee paid in the tax year | Percentage of independent living monthly fees paid in the tax year |
|---|---|---|
| LifeChoice Declining Balance Plan | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| LifeChoice 50% Refundable Plan | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| LifeChoice 75% Refundable Plan | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| LifeChoice 90% Refundable Plan | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| LifeCare Declining Balance Plan | 34.6 | 38.5 |
| LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan | 21.8 | 38.5 |

Under all six plans the tax letter is issued by 01-31 (January 31) of the year following the tax year.

## Notes

- Only the two LifeCare plans carry percentages above 0.0; the four LifeChoice plans carry 0.0 in both columns.
- The two LifeCare plans share the 38.5 percent monthly fee percentage and differ in the entrance fee percentage: 34.6 for the Declining Balance Plan and 21.8 for the 90% Refundable Plan.
